items.name: 2026 capital expenditure and turnaround guidance
items.claim: Par Pacific guided 2026 capital expenditure and turnaround outlay to a range of $190 million to $220 million.
items.source_excerpt: Par Pacific Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: PARR) (“Par Pacific”) today announced its 2026 capital expenditure and turnaround outlay guidance with a range of $190 million to $220 million .

notes: Only stored source is the 2026 capex guidance release; no named contract, backlog, or single named project beyond the aggregate turnaround/growth capital split.
